body.x: PUBL Studio(www.publ-studio.com) showcased Game& Education Convergence Content at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

PUBL Studio has developed Little Detective K, Picture Book, Brain Puzzle, MapleStory as its new concept appbooks. PUBL Studio holds about 1,000 contents now based on the education system connecting to games.

PUBL Studio has developed a lot of interactive appbooks for Kids in contract with 'Rovio', the globally Angry Birds franchise, Nexon of 'MapleStory' and 'Highlights' learning book company in US. Those contracts had made the company to be known global-wide.
The official said "We plan to have meeting with global game companies since our goal later in the year is to establish the company in America. We will expand the business widely to different area"

PUBL Studio participated in the show as it had been selected for excellent startups by SmartContentCenter. PUBL Studio equally placed its service to let foreign reporters learn the service at Showstoppers which was important media press event. Furthermore, PUBL Studio had chance to get advice on global marketing from Strong Ventures CEO John Nam, Tapas media CEO Chang-Won Kim, KOTRA SV Sung-Kyu Lee at 3:1 'CES Global Consulting Program'

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
